messages:
sam_cs: Heads-up — Hydrolyx onboarding: their doc-QA flow has high tail latency and token costs. p95 460ms, p99 1.3s, avg tokens ~1100. Renewal check in 10 days.

mia_ml: Two low-risk moves + one experimental: 1) int8 on compact (low risk), 2) route by route-type for doc-QA to compact, 3) experimental: staged int4 trial for doc-heavy requests (big cost wins but monitor quality).

jorge_infra: We can provision a separated trial pool and constrain routing by route_type+token_length. Need clear acceptance + rollback criteria from CS.

zack_success: Acceptance: p95 < 320ms OR cost per 1k tokens -25% with semantic-sim quality delta <=1.2%. Immediate rollback if client flags quality, ROUGE loss >1.5% or error_rate >1%.

mia_ml: Pilot plan (draft):

```yaml
pilot_name: hydrolyx-hybrid-int4-trial
steps:
  - pct: 10
    model: redwood/compact-hybrid
    quant: int4_experimental_A
    route_filter: route_type:doc-QA
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - wait: 6h
  - pct: 30
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - emb_sim_quality_delta: "<=1.2%"
```

sam_cs: Client contact: tinah@hydrolyx.ai, available Wed 2pm PT. Ill schedule a 30min enablement call to align on tradeoffs and capture example prompts.

jorge_infra: Routing prototype I'll apply: {"route_policy":"route_type_and_length","conditions":{"route_type":"doc-QA","min_tokens":800},"dest":"hydrolyx-hybrid-int4-trial","fallback":"llm-standard"} — will gate to 10% and attach tracing.

ops-bot: Trial pool "hydrolyx-hybrid-int4-trial" queued by jorge_infra. Start epoch 4822230000. Monitoring hooks attached. Alerts: p95>320ms, error_rate>1%, quality_delta>1.2%. :rocket:

zack_success: On the call well capture subjective feedback (perceived latency, any semantic drift) and add failing examples to their eval set for quick rollback tuning.

sam_cs: Next steps: 1) enablement call Wed 2pm PT (Ill send invite), 2) jorge provisions 10% pilot (ops-bot queued), 3) mia finalizes int4 safety checks + one-pager, 4) monitor 72h and collect examples, 5) scale to 30% only if p95 <320ms and quality_delta <=1.2%. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
